newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Woolworth in supermarket talks.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Woolworth in supermarket talks.

text.p: Woolworth Cyprus is negotiating the takeover of the Charalambides Hypermarket in Nicosia, a company release said on Monday.
The release did not offer any further details. The Charalambides Hypermarket, which opened late last year, is one of the largest in the capital.
Woolworth Cyprus, a wholly-owned subsidiary of N.K.S. Shakolas (Holdings) Ltd., has five department stores on the island and is scheduled to open a sixth store in Nicosia later this year.
"We believe the negotiations will be concluded soon, possibly today," a spokesman for N.K.S. Shakolas said.
